chunks: And one of his sayings (peace be upon him) was when he was attending to the funeral ablution (ghusl) of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and shrouding him.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say while washing the Prophet's body?
ai.summary: This narration, recorded by Sharif al-Radi in *Nahj al-Balagha*, captures Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) unique role as the primary mourner and ritual purifier of the Prophet, emphasizing the continuity of spiritual authority from the Prophet to his cousin and son-in-law. It underscores the Shia belief in the familial and spiritual bond that persisted even in the physical separation of death, marking Ali’s transition from companion to the sole inheritor of the Prophet’s inner knowledge.
